# Gemstone & Setting Templates

![_Templates.  Jewelry Templates. Gemstone & Setting Templates. AP | Pivtorak.Studio. 30.10.2026_ © Anna Pivtorak (Kostyuk)](/images/templates-jewelry-templates-gemstone-and-setting-templates.webp)

_Educational Worksheets For Gemstone Identification, Measurement, Inventory, Matching, And Setting._

Gemstone & Setting Templates provide structured worksheets for documenting gemstone characteristics, recording measurements, organizing stone inventories, and describing setting specifications. They help students understand how gemstones are identified, classified, compared, and incorporated into jewelry designs. The collection covers individual stone records, parcel inventories, layout and matching, setting specifications, and quality inspection. Each template introduces the essential terminology and information used in gemstone documentation and jewelry practice, presenting it in a clear and accessible format suitable for art-history education, design studies, and introductory technical research.

<div style="border: 1px solid #f2c94c; background-color: #fff8e1; padding: 16px; border-radius: 10px; margin: 20px 0;"> <p style="margin: 0 0 10px 0; font-weight: 600;"> 🚧 Page Under Development </p> <p style="margin: 0;"> This page is currently under development. Gemstone documentation and setting worksheets will be added as they are prepared and reviewed. </p> </div>

## Gemstone Identification & Measurement Record

An individual record for documenting the identity and physical characteristics of a gemstone. It introduces the basic information used to describe and distinguish individual stones, including their type, shape, cut, dimensions, weight, and visual properties.

**Includes:** Gemstone identification, variety, cut and shape, dimensions, carat weight, colour, transparency, and identification reference.

**Format:** PDF

## Gemstone Parcel Inventory Sheet

An inventory worksheet for recording and organizing groups of gemstones. It helps students understand how stones are classified, counted, measured, and documented as part of a collection or parcel.

**Includes:** Parcel identification, gemstone type, quantity, shape, dimensions, individual or total weight, supplier or origin information, and notes.

**Formats:** PDF, XLSX

## Stone Layout & Matching Sheet

A worksheet for documenting the arrangement and selection of gemstones within a jewelry design. It illustrates how stones can be organized according to their position, size, shape, colour, and visual correspondence, particularly in symmetrical or repeated compositions.

**Includes:** Stone positions, identification references, size sequence, colour matching, shape correspondence, symmetry, and layout notes.

**Format:** PDF

## Stone Setting Specification Sheet

A technical worksheet describing the intended method and basic parameters for setting gemstones in a jewelry piece. It helps students recognize different setting types and understand the relationship between a gemstone, its seat, and the surrounding metal structure.

**Includes:** Setting type, stone quantity and positions, stone dimensions, setting and seat parameters, basic structural characteristics, and design notes.

**Format:** PDF

## Setting Inspection Checklist

A checklist for understanding the visual and basic technical inspection of gemstone settings. It introduces the main points considered when evaluating the security, alignment, symmetry, and overall appearance of stones set in jewelry.

**Includes:** Stone security, alignment, symmetry, prong or bezel condition, visible stone damage, seating, and general setting quality.

**Format:** PDF
